exposure: cannabidiol (CBD) at low therapeutic concentration (250 ng/mL)
cannabidiol (CBD) at high therapeutic concentration (1000 ng/mL)
outcome: CBD concentrations in maternal and fetal compartments and placental tissue
cohort: Placentas were obtained from healthy women undergoing cesarean deliveries.
finding: The placenta acts as a depot compartment for CBD, sequestering it in tissue and significantly slowing its distribution to the fetus.
